record: render verification — phase 22 (JOB SOA01-FINAL-MERGE). The final merged build rendered TWICE from the phase-21 programmes + the phase-22 merged scenes: once per voice. The two renders differ ONLY in voice (programme + the PLAN timings derived from it) — same merged text, same scene design, same chain. Level-matched at the programme stage (phase 21) so the owner's two-video experiment compares voices, not loudness.
procedure: CDP deterministic seek-capture of each scene at 30 fps (window.__seek per frame, private Chrome port per render) + ffmpeg mux with the programme WAV (libx264 crf 20, AAC 192 kb/s, faststart) — the branch procedure of phases 15/18.
capture_incidents: Clone capture died silently twice mid-run (renderer exits masked by the shell chain — the phase-18 incident class): at frames 431 and 1309 of 1618. Both times it was RESUMED deterministically from the on-disk frame count — renderAt(t) is a pure function of t, so a resumed capture is frame-identical to a continuous one; the final count verified exactly (1618) and the seam frame f1309 (the second resume point, mid-payoff) was viewed: continuous with its neighbours. The default capture completed in one pass (1484/1484). NOTE: an automated completion notice for the default capture arrived while the renderer was still at ~frame 1200 and was DISREGARDED — all counts here were verified on disk and in the renderer log ('done 1484'), never on the notice. Hash note: the mux run's automated completion notice carried a STALE sha for the clone render; every hash and measurement in this record was re-read from the delivered files on disk at staging time (file, measure JSON and staged copies agree: clone 6d8cbe1e…, default 17bbfe48…).
qa_frames_viewed: Viewed by the producing agent's own eyes: scene stills at the naming beat (ring label THE HARNESS at the L8 word), the claim beat (label YOUR HARNESS at the L9 word), the tint window, the swap beat (green ring, core ANOTHER MODEL at the L11 word), the machine arrival in the post-proof silence, the relay (payoff + HADOSH ACADEMY tag + L13 band), and the bridge card — for BOTH builds; plus frames extracted from the rendered MP4s (clone naming + bridge; default relay) and the clone capture's seam frame f1309. One defect found and fixed pre-render: the machine's first merged timing (V1 relationship, arrival during L10) hid the core swap behind the layer exit; corrected to the V2 relationship (arrival in the designed silence after the proof) and re-verified in stills.
onset: Visual onset exact at 1.200 s by construction (the PLAN starts L1 at 1.200; frame 36 is the first L1 frame in both captures). Audio onset provenance: the renders' audio streams are the phase-21 programme WAVs muxed unaltered (hashes below); the voice-track onset probes of record are phase 21's (clone lead-in measured 1.202 s on the assembled voice track, +2 ms; default first-phrase +153 ms slow-phoneme rise, recorded there).
